items.title: Derived bodies (DERIVED_SOURCE) are never filed on the record, so every Class A/D pass re-walks them on every keystroke - the bulk of the served leaf's ~126k always-live entities on kolt
items.kind: performance (incremental analyzer; the M110 arc's next lever)
items.status: OPEN - filed 2026-11-03 (lane incr-56's find; M110 arc)
items.discussion: lane incr-56 (Order 56): M188's first version raised leaf instructions 0.4% because all 9,067 always-live Retain rows were derived bodies; M189's memo still scans 1,943 of ~5,900 closures for the same reason; the hover index fix (eb268d5c, implementors_in_reach 1.39 G = 13.4% of the keystroke) and the const pass's staged-liveness loop (0.79 G) were the two largest single costs and are fixed in place - what remains is structural
items.body: A derived body (a `[derive(..)]` expansion) is deterministic in its item's declaration, so its rows (Retain, LastUse, contexts, const) could be filed under the ITEM's key and restored with it, like any class D row; today the derive is re-expanded and re-walked live because DERIVED_SOURCE entities have no file to be filed under. Rec: file derived rows under the deriving item's record (keyed by the item + the derive's name), restore them on a hit, invalidate with the item; the census counts `derived-rows-restored`; the differential plant drops the restore. Measure on the N186 series (the leaf row; expect the always-live lane to shrink by the derived share). Sizing M-L; pass map §7.2 has the Order 56 sizing paragraph.

items.title: The `.len() as i32` refusal's note ("this stage returns `usize`") changes its SPAN with module names and order - 292..297 vs 295..300 under the permutation differential's ReversedNames - a diagnostic whose span depends on an unrelated module's name
items.discussion: lane incr-56 (Order 56): met when a RETAIN fixture's `as i32` added a second error to `permutation::every_other_fixture`; the fixture was moved to `.as_i32()` (9e1393dd); R11_FIXTURES carries the same `as i32` but is not in the permutation chain, so it never showed
items.body: The note's span is computed from an offset that includes module-name text (a prefix length), so a renamed module shifts it. Rec: compute the note span from the expression's own node span; pin by adding an `as i32` fixture to the permutation chain (the one 9e1393dd backed out). Sizing XS-S.
